profile.summary: Five years building and securing production systems. Led a company-wide financial database migration, shipped a school platform used by 504 institutions, delivered full-stack work for 19 brands.
profile.bio: Full-stack developer and cybersecurity analyst in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

stats.label: Schools on a platform I built

expertise.title: Full-stack development
expertise.description: End-to-end web and mobile products. React and Angular front ends on Spring, Node and Django services, with payment and LMS integrations.

expertise.title: Databases
expertise.description: Schema design, query optimization and warehousing on Oracle, PostgreSQL and SQL Server. Led a full financial-system migration end to end.

expertise.title: Cybersecurity
expertise.description: Network security, risk assessment, security auditing and log analysis. CompTIA Security+ and a Seneca postgraduate certificate.

description: Led the migration of the company's financial databases and software functionalities to a new company infrastructure, ensuring security, data integrity, and seamless integration with existing systems.
Created and updated comprehensive software manuals, ensuring clear communication of technical processes for daily operations, and enhancing user understanding of system functionalities.
Designed complex pipelines using Linux bash script commands to make the compilation and build process faster, optimizing the integration of new software to the system.
Implemented school webapp for over 504 Ecuadorian schools, focusing on responsive design, user-friendly navigation, and enhancing overall user experience for students, parents, and staff.
Front-end and mobile development using web technologies to facilitate posting and managing of homework and online-classes, prioritizing network traffic and minimizing delays.
Used Canvas LMS REST API with AJAX to create single page dashboards for students and professors without reloading the pages, ensuring a fast update and smoother experience.
Content creation to provide digital marketing services and manage social media content for Ecuadorian companies, optimizing user experience and increasing online visibility for 19 local brands.
Development and maintenance of an end-to-end website and Android application, utilizing both front-end and back-end technologies, ensuring a seamless user experience and robust functionality.
Used Paymentez API for online payments, establishing a secure connection and giving feedback of each stage of the payment until the transaction was completed.
